title: Netgate pfSense CE XMLRPC Incorrect Authorization Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
description:
This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Netgate pfSense. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability.
The specific flaw exists within the XMLRPC endpoint. The issue results from incorrect authorization prior to allowing access to functionality. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code within the context of the root.
addtionnal_details:
Netgate has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. More details can be found at:
https://docs.netgate.com/downloads/pfSense-SA-26_22.webgui.asc
timeline:
2026-08-25 - Vulnerability reported to vendor
2026-11-13 - Coordinated public release of advisory
2026-11-13  - Advisory Updated
